title: •••Rodian
caption: •••Rodian (V)
game_text: Once per game, may ▼ a bounty hunter (except Greedo) to same site. Unless another •••Rodian is at same or a related site, your Force drain bonuses at same planet site may not be canceled.
lore: Thuku is a typical male Rodian. Sent to hunt down Greedo by Navik the Red, head of the Chattza tribe. Rodians enjoy “the hunt,” so many are employed as assassins.
